## Goal
Read-only review of the website's design tokens (web/src/styles/tokens.css) and shared components (web/src/components/)
for text/background contrast (WCAG AA: 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI) in light and dark, and for visible keyboard
focus. Existing coverage to read first and not duplicate: tests/test_web_faq_accessibility.py, tests/test_web_header_navigation.py,
docs/handoff/web-qa.md.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- docs/vendor/web-contrast-audit.md: each finding with file:line, the two colours, the ratio (computed from the token
  values, labelled "computed") and a proposed fix with its owner (web-designer in-house). Clearly separate verified from unverified.
- No other file changes. The families page is out of scope (Codex WO-118 audited it).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- docs/vendor/web-contrast-audit.md (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
web/ and everything else (read only).
